title: probe: one snapshot of the tree under a pid from /proc
body: Walk /proc for every process whose ppid chain reaches the root. Per process: pid, ppid, comm, argv (cmdline), start time (stat field 22, clock ticks since boot), utime+stime (the process total that includes threads already gone), rss, and per thread the nanoseconds on cpu from task/<tid>/schedstat field 1. A Snapshot is a Vec<Process>; a Process that vanished between reading the directory and its files is skipped, not an error. Behind a Probe trait with cfg(target_os = linux) on the impl so a second platform is one file.
